environment.description: AWS Lambda function behind API Gateway (REST API) with Lambda proxy integration. Deployment includes an auxiliary credential rotation Lambda (triggered by EventBridge every 60 seconds) that rotates the DynamoDB access credentials stored in Secrets Manager, invalidating any previously-issued temporary session tokens. The API Gateway stage has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with a custom rule group containing a RegexPatternSet match condition on query string parameters using pattern `(?:<[^>]*script|javascript:|on\w+\s*=)` with action BLOCK (priority 1), plus the AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with CrossSiteScripting_QUERYARGUMENTS rule in COUNT mode as a secondary signal. The credential rotation ensures that even if an attacker exfiltrates session nonces or temporary credentials via XSS, they expire within the 60-second rotation window before lateral movement is possible. CloudWatch alarm triggers on WAF BLOCK metrics with SNS notification to security team.
